knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(GSVA)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(pheatmap)
library(readr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(fgsea)

library(readxl)

library(limma)
```

```{r}
rna = read.csv("data/raw rna/thyroid_rna_counts_112.csv")

tumor_samples_final = read.csv("data/1tumor_samples_final_68.csv")

tumor_rna = rna %>% 
  dplyr::select(1, any_of(tumor_samples_final$sample_id))
rownames(tumor_rna) = tumor_rna[[1]]
tumor_rna = tumor_rna[ , -1]
```

```{r}
tumor_clinical_dds = tumor_samples_final %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample_id, group) %>% 
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(tumor_rna), sample_id))

tumor_clinical_dds$group <- factor(
  tumor_clinical_dds$group,
  levels = c("WTC-unexposed", "WTC-exposed")
)
```

```{r}
rna_round = round(tumor_rna)

dds = DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = rna_round,
  colData   = tumor_clinical_dds,   
  design    = ~ group     
)
```

```{r}
smallest_group = 3
keep = rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= smallest_group
dds = dds[keep, ]
```

```{r}
dds$group = relevel(dds$group, ref = "WTC-unexposed")
dds = DESeq(dds)
```

```{r}
res = results(dds, contrast = c("group", "WTC-exposed", "WTC-unexposed"))
res = res[order(res$padj), ]
res_df = as.data.frame(res)
res_df$ensembl_id = rownames(res_df)
res_df = res_df %>% filter(!is.na(padj))

res_df = res_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1.5  ~ "Up",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1.5 ~ "Down",
      TRUE                              ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
gene_map = readRDS("data/ensembl115_gene_map.rds")

res_hgnc = merge(
  res_df,
  gene_map[, c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype")],
  by.x = "ensembl_id",
  by.y = "ensembl_gene_id",
  all.x = TRUE  # keep all ensembl genes even if they don't map to hgnc
)

res_hgnc = res_hgnc %>% 
  dplyr::filter(hgnc_symbol != "")

res_hgnc = res_hgnc[, c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype", setdiff(names(res_hgnc), c("hgnc_symbol","gene_biotype")))]

duplicated_hgnc = res_hgnc$hgnc_symbol[duplicated(res_hgnc$hgnc_symbol)]
dup_hgnc_deseq = res_hgnc[res_hgnc$hgnc_symbol %in% duplicated_hgnc, ]

res_hgnc$hgnc_unique = ave(
  res_hgnc$hgnc_symbol,
  res_hgnc$hgnc_symbol,
  FUN = function(x) {
    if (length(x) == 1) {
      x
    } else {
      paste0(x, ".", seq_along(x))
    }
  }
)
res_hgnc$hgnc_symbol = res_hgnc$hgnc_unique
res_hgnc$hgnc_unique = NULL
```

```{r}
res_hgnc_protein = res_hgnc %>% 
  dplyr::filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding")

sig_genes = res_hgnc_protein[res_hgnc_protein$significance %in% c("Up", "Down"), ]
top_genes = sig_genes[order(-abs(sig_genes$log2FoldChange)), ][1:40, ]

volcano_hgnc_protein = ggplot(res_hgnc_protein, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1.5, 1.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_genes,
    aes(label = hgnc_symbol),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "firebrick3",
      "Down" = "dodgerblue4",
      "Not Significant" = "grey"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Up" = "Upregulated",
      "Down" = "Downregulated",
      "Not Significant" = "Not Significant"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (WTC-exposed vs WTC-unexposed)",
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value"
  ) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

```

```{r}
res_df$ensembl_id = sub("\\..*", "", res_df$ensembl_id)

annot = bitr(
  res_df$ensembl_id,
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType = c("GENETYPE"),
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)
res_annot = merge(
  res_df,
  annot,
  by.x = "ensembl_id",
  by.y = "ENSEMBL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

res_protein_ensembl = res_annot[res_annot$GENETYPE == "protein-coding", ]

res_protein_sig = res_protein_ensembl[res_protein_ensembl$significance %in% c("Up", "Down"), ]

res_protein_sig = res_protein_sig[!is.na(res_protein_sig$padj), ]

idx = match(res_protein_sig$ensembl_id, rownames(tumor_rna))
idx = idx[!is.na(idx)]

tumor_rna_de = tumor_rna[idx, , drop = FALSE]

exposure_df = tumor_clinical_dds[
  match(colnames(tumor_rna_de), tumor_clinical_dds$sample_id),
]

exposure_vector = exposure_df$group
names(exposure_vector) = colnames(tumor_rna_de)

col_order = c(
  names(exposure_vector[exposure_vector == "WTC-unexposed"]),
  names(exposure_vector[exposure_vector == "WTC-exposed"])
)
rna_ordered = tumor_rna_de[, col_order, drop = FALSE]

annotation_col = data.frame(
  Exposure = factor(exposure_vector[col_order],
                    levels = c("WTC-unexposed", "WTC-exposed"))
)
rownames(annotation_col) = colnames(rna_ordered)

rna_log = log2(rna_ordered + 1)

case_cols = which(annotation_col$Exposure == "WTC-exposed")
control_cols = which(annotation_col$Exposure == "WTC-unexposed")

row_mean_case = rowMeans(rna_log[, case_cols, drop = FALSE])
row_mean_control = rowMeans(rna_log[, control_cols, drop = FALSE])

gene_order = order(row_mean_case - row_mean_control, decreasing = TRUE)
top_rna_ordered = rna_log[gene_order, , drop = FALSE]

pheatmap(
  top_rna_ordered,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  scale = "row",
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = list(
    Exposure = c("WTC-unexposed" = "lightskyblue1",
                 "WTC-exposed" = "royalblue4")
  ),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  treeheight_row = 0,
  border_color = NA,
  breaks = seq(-2.25, 2.25, length.out = 101)
)
```

down_genes = gsub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", protein_down$hgnc_symbol)

all_DE = res_hgnc_protein %>%

```{r}
msig_h = msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  collection = "H"
)

pathways = split(msig_h$ensembl_gene, msig_h$gs_name)
```

```{r}
gene_list = res_protein_ensembl$log2FoldChange
names(gene_list) = res_protein_ensembl$ensembl_id

gene_list = gene_list[!is.na(gene_list)]
gene_list = sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)
```

```{r}
fgseaRes = fgsea(
  pathways = pathways,
  stats    = gene_list
)

fgseaRes$pathway = gsub("HALLMARK_", "", fgseaRes$pathway)
```

```{r}
fgsea_plot = fgseaRes %>%
  mutate(
    log10padj = -log10(padj),
    log10padj = pmin(log10padj, 50),
    significance = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & NES > 2  ~ "Over-enriched",
      padj < 0.05 & NES < -2 ~ "Under-enriched",
      TRUE                   ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  )

volcano_gsea = ggplot(
  fgsea_plot,
  aes(x = NES, y = log10padj, color = significance)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(fgsea_plot, significance != "Not Significant"),
    aes(label = pathway),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 20
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Over-enriched" = "firebrick3",
    "Under-enriched" = "dodgerblue4",
    "Not Significant" = "grey"
  )) +

  theme_minimal() +

  labs(
    title = " ",
    x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value"
  ) +

  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```

```{r}
ref = read_excel("data/haocheng_nanostring_ref.xlsx", sheet = 3)
colnames(ref) = as.character(unlist(ref[1, ]))
ref = ref[-1, ]

celltype_markers = ref %>% 
  dplyr::select(`HUGO Name`, `Cell Type`) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(`Cell Type`))

celltype_sets = split(celltype_markers$`HUGO Name`, celltype_markers$`Cell Type`)
```

```{r}
dge = DGEList(counts = tumor_rna)

dge = calcNormFactors(dge)

log_rna = cpm(dge, log = TRUE)
```

```{r}
gene_map = readRDS("data/ensembl115_gene_map.rds")

log_rna = as.data.frame(log_rna)
log_rna$ensembl_gene_id = rownames(log_rna)
log_rna_hgnc = merge(
  log_rna,
  gene_map[, c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype")],
  by = "ensembl_gene_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

log_rna_hgnc = log_rna_hgnc %>% 
  dplyr::filter(hgnc_symbol != "")

log_rna_hgnc = log_rna_hgnc[, c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype", setdiff(names(log_rna_hgnc), c("hgnc_symbol","gene_biotype")))]

tumor_rna_norm_hgnc = log_rna_hgnc %>% 
  dplyr::select(-ensembl_gene_id, -gene_biotype)

tumor_rna_norm_hgnc = tumor_rna_norm_hgnc %>%
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric))),
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol")
```

```{r}
tumor_rna_norm_hgnc_protein = log_rna_hgnc %>% 
  dplyr::filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding")
tumor_rna_norm_hgnc_protein = tumor_rna_norm_hgnc_protein %>% 
  dplyr::select(-ensembl_gene_id, -gene_biotype)

tumor_rna_norm_hgnc_protein = tumor_rna_norm_hgnc_protein %>%
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = rowMeans(across(where(is.numeric))),
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol")
```

```{r}
tumor_rna_norm_hgnc_protein = as.matrix(tumor_rna_norm_hgnc_protein)

param = gsvaParam(
  exprData = tumor_rna_norm_hgnc_protein,
  geneSets = celltype_sets,  
  kcdf = "Gaussian",
  maxDiff = TRUE
)

gsva_scores = gsva(param)
```

```{r}
exposure_df = exposure_df[match(colnames(gsva_scores), exposure_df$sample_id), ]

exposure_df$group = factor(exposure_df$group, levels = c("WTC-unexposed", "WTC-exposed"))

annotation_col = data.frame(Exposure = exposure_df$group)
rownames(annotation_col) = exposure_df$sample_id
col_order  rownames(annotation_col)[order(annotation_col$Exposure)]
gsva_scores = gsva_scores[, col_order, drop = FALSE]
annotation_ordered = annotation_col[col_order, , drop = FALSE]

gsva_group = factor(annotation_ordered$Exposure,
                          levels = c("WTC-unexposed", "WTC-exposed")) 
gsva_design = model.matrix(~ gsva_group)

gsva_fit = lmFit(gsva_scores, gsva_design)

gsva_fit = eBayes(gsva_fit)

gsva_results = topTable(gsva_fit, 
                              coef = "gsva_groupWTC-exposed", 
                              number = Inf)
gsva_results$pathway = rownames(gsva_results)

gsva_results$significance = "Not Significant"
gsva_results$significance[
  gsva_results$adj.P.Val < 0.1 & gsva_results$logFC > 0
] <- "Up"
gsva_results$significance[
  gsva_results$adj.P.Val < 0.1 & gsva_results$logFC < 0
] <- "Down"

gsva_results = gsva_results[, c(
  "pathway", "logFC", "AveExpr", "t", 
  "P.Value", "adj.P.Val", "significance"
)]

limma_gsva_results = gsva_results[order(gsva_results$adj.P.Val), ]
limma_gsva_results$pathway = gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", limma_gsva_results$pathway)
rownames(limma_gsva_results) = gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", rownames(limma_gsva_results))
```

```{r}
set.seed(222)
volcano_cell = ggplot(limma_gsva_results, 
                       aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  
  # Threshold lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = limma_gsva_results,
    aes(label = pathway),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 20
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "firebrick3",
                                "Down" = "dodgerblue4",
                                "Not Significant" = "grey50"),
    labels = c(
      "Up" = "More abundant",
      "Down" = "Less abundant",
      "Not Significant" = "Not Significant"
    )) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = " ",
       x = "Difference in Mean GSVA Score (WTC-exposed - WTC-unexposed)",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```
